name: vrooli-memory.choose-option
purpose: Choose among current caller-approved options using exact-context structured memory advice, retaining a deterministic fallback without executing any option.
assumptions: The domain owner supplies the allowed set
Memory is advice, never execution authority
invariants: No binding or model is called
No option outside the allowed set is returned
Conflicting and truncated advice cannot override the fallback

signals.learning: Explicit advice decisions for parent capture

outputs.evidence: Matched advice entry IDs; not task outcome proof

budget.async_reason: The choice read can cross the memory service boundary beyond the one-second synchronous budget; callers wait once for its terminal result.
